name: CRaQAn
description: CRaQAn is an open-source dataset for coreference resolution in question-answering tasks, containing over 250 question-answer pairs with coreferences. It supports research on information retrieval challenges in instruction-following language models.
reputation: A small, recent open-source benchmark from the paper’s authors that is mainly used as a niche research dataset for coreference-in-QA rather than a widely adopted standard.
notes: Dataset creation methodology uses GPT-4 and a Recursive Criticism and Improvement Loop.
